veranderings.voor: die Oos-Kaap, die Vredefortkoepel in die Vrystaat
veranderings.na: die Oos-Kaap. Die Vredefortkoepel staan in die Vrystaat
veranderings.rede: The elliptical second clause after a comma reads as if the Vredefortkoepel were a further item in the Kaapse blommeryk's location; a separate sentence matching its neighbours is clearer.
